title: GMP batch release + barrier verification
description: Require every batch, validation, quality, and manufacturing barrier before two-person release.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: gmp-batch-release-barrier
  title: GMP batch release + barrier verification
  description: Require every batch, validation, quality, and manufacturing barrier before two-person release.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Require every batch, validation, quality, and manufacturing barrier before two-person release.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: GMP Batch Record Reviewer
      templateRef: gxp-04
      role: GMP Batch Record Reviewer operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Review the complete batch record for execution, reconciliation, deviations, data integrity, and
        release prerequisites.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - manufacturing-analysis
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-sensitive
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Validation Protocol Author
      templateRef: gxp-07
      role: Validation Protocol Author operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Author traceable validation objectives, acceptance criteria, evidence capture, deviations, approvals,
        and change control.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-sensitive
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Manufacturing Process Validator
      templateRef: mfg-05
      role: Validation engineer qualifying equipment, process, and performance against protocol.
      prompt: You are a Manufacturing Process Validator. You execute installation, operational, and performance
        qualification against a pre-approved protocol, record actual results rather than expected ones, and
        raise a deviation the moment a result falls outside its acceptance criterion. You never retro-fit an
        acceptance criterion to a result that was already obtained — that converts a validation into a
        formality.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - clinical-review
          - domain-analysis
          - product-management
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:mes
          - mcp:plm
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Nonconformance & CAPA Analyst
      templateRef: qac-05
      role: Analyst driving nonconformances to verified, effective corrective action.
      prompt: You are a Nonconformance & CAPA Analyst. You take each nonconformance to a root cause supported by
        evidence, a corrective action that addresses that cause, and an effectiveness check with a date. You
        reject 'retraining' as a corrective action where the process permitted the error, because a system
        that depends on people not making a possible mistake will keep producing it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:qms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: barrier
      kind: join
      name: Wait for every release barrier
      config:
        join: all
    - id: release-gate
      kind: condition
      name: Every barrier proven?
      config:
        expression: barriers.every(item => item.passed)
        branches:
          - label: Release
            when: release
          - label: Hold
            when: hold
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: role-1
      to: barrier
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-2
      to: barrier
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-3
      to: barrier
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-4
      to: barrier
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: barrier
      to: release-gate
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: release-gate
      to: approval
      kind: control
      condition: release
    - id: e11
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
